In cases where the infection is more severe or persistent, such as moccasin-type athlete's foot with thickened skin, prescription-strength topical antifungals like ketoconazole may be required, as they are better able to penetrate the thickened skin layers [1]. Furthermore, some homeopathic or natural formulations, such as those containing tea tree oil, have demonstrated antifungal and antibacterial properties and may support treatment, although they may not fully eliminate the infection on their own [1]. description: Can vitamin D supplements improve the management of asthma?
